description: Search the bounded Lots of Sounds CC0 catalog by keyword, tags, category, and duration. A connected account is required. Each word in the query must match the sound name, description or a tag, so use short keywords and narrow the search with tags or max_duration. Results include timing (onset, peak and tail in milliseconds) and loudness (LUFS and true peak) when the sound has been analysed.

q.description: Keywords, e.g. 'card shuffle'. Every word must match the name, description or a tag. Use short words, not a sentence.
